notes: The page prints three photography sections: DIGITAL PHOTOGRAPHY and PHOTOGRAPHY (both under 'PHOTOGRAPHY AS DEGREE OR CERTIFICATE') and a separate PHOTOGRAPHY AA DEGREE. The PHOTOGRAPHY section was chosen because its course list matches the closed list exactly (including PHOTO 101 and PHOTO 103); it serves both the AS degree and the certificate.

The catalog states 'This program requires 18 units', but the section lists 8 required courses plus one elective; at the 3 units each the state file stores for several of them this would be about 27 units, which matches the award's 16-to-under-30 range. The printed 18 is recorded as stated; a reviewer should check it.
The catalog prints no units beside courses, so all course units are null.
The outcomes are printed as one run-in sentence separated by commas; they were split into four outcomes at the verb phrases. The PDF ligature 'workﬂ ows' was read as 'workflows'.

Careers recorded are the job titles named ('principal photographers, photography assistants or as digital retouchers'); the description also mentions careers in photographic practices 'from commercial and fine art to documentary and event photography', which were not split into separate entries.
Closed-list codes PHOTO101, PHOTO112, PHOTO130, PHOTO132, PHOTO142, PHOTO146 lack a space in the state file; the catalog's 'PHOTO 101' etc. are treated as the same courses.
